contracts.name: Pattern
contracts.signature: interface Pattern { id: string; name: string; units: 'mm'; pieces: Piece[]; materials: Material[]; hardware: Hardware[]; steps: Step[]; meta: PatternMeta }

contracts.name: Piece
contracts.signature: interface Piece { id: string; name: string; mirror: boolean; quantity: number; paths: Path[]; materialId?: string; annotations?: PieceAnnotation[]; seamAllowances?: Record<EdgeId, number> }

contracts.name: Edge
contracts.signature: type Edge = Straight | Arc | Bezier (each with id, role: 'cut' | 'fold' | 'stitch' | 'seam' | 'notch')

contracts.name: Step
contracts.signature: interface Step { id: string; title: string; body: string; dependsOn: string[]; refsPieces: string[]; group?: string }

contracts.name: offsetPath
contracts.signature: function offsetPath(path: Path, sa: number | Record<EdgeId, number>): Result<Path, OffsetError>

contracts.name: exportSvg
contracts.signature: function exportSvg(pattern: Pattern, opts?: SvgOptions): string

contracts.name: loadPdfExporter
contracts.signature: async function loadPdfExporter(): Promise<{ exportPdf: (pattern: Pattern, opts: PdfOptions) => Promise<Blob> }>

contracts.name: loadDxfExporter
contracts.signature: async function loadDxfExporter(): Promise<{ exportDxf: (pattern: Pattern) => string }>

contracts.name: loadTiledHtmlExporter
contracts.signature: async function loadTiledHtmlExporter(): Promise<{ exportTiledHtml: (pattern: Pattern, opts: TileOptions) => string }>

contracts.name: computeCutList
contracts.signature: function computeCutList(pattern: Pattern): { byMaterial: Array<{ materialId; totalAreaMm2; pieces: string[] }>; byHardware: Array<{ hardwareId; count }> }

contracts.name: importProjectJson
contracts.signature: function importProjectJson<T>(json: string, schema: InputSchema<T>): Result<ProjectEnvelope<T>, ImportError>

contracts.name: TriZipInputs
contracts.signature: TriZipInputs — see types.ts; includes height, width, depth, units, stylePresetName, and per-section parameter overrides

contracts.name: STYLE_PRESETS
contracts.signature: Six named presets: urban_assault, tactical, hiking, camera, medical, minimalist

contracts.name: buildPattern
contracts.signature: function buildPattern(inputs: TriZipInputs, preset: StylePreset): Result<Pattern, BuildError>

contracts.name: PATTERNS
contracts.signature: PatternRegistryEntry[] — consumed by LandingPage and App.tsx for view switching

contracts.name: useTriZipProject
contracts.signature: function useTriZipProject(): { project; updateInputs; setPreset; resetProject; importProject; storageWarning }
